prompt.en: How large was Canada's navy at the end of the Second World War?
prompt.fr: Quelle était l'importance de la marine canadienne à la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale?

options.en: The third-largest navy in the world.
options.fr: La troisième marine en importance au monde.

options.en: The largest navy in the world.
options.fr: La plus grande marine au monde.

options.en: The tenth-largest navy in the world.
options.fr: La dixième marine en importance au monde.

options.en: The largest navy in the Commonwealth after Britain and Australia.
options.fr: La plus grande marine du Commonwealth après celles de la Grande-Bretagne et de l'Australie.

explanation.en: The Royal Canadian Navy is remembered above all for the Atlantic, where it shepherded merchant convoys through waters full of German submarines. By 1945 only two navies in the world were larger.
explanation.fr: On se souvient surtout de la Marine royale canadienne pour l'Atlantique, où elle escortait les convois marchands dans des eaux infestées de sous-marins allemands. En 1945, seules deux marines au monde étaient plus grandes.

source.quote: At the end of the Second World War, Canada had the third-largest navy in the world.

verification.evidence: The Royal Canadian Navy (RCN) saw its finest hour in the Battle of the Atlantic, protecting convoys of merchant ships against German submarines. Canada’s Merchant Navy helped to feed, clothe and resupply Britain. At the end of the Second World War, Canada had the third-largest navy in the world.
